lesson.intro: Frasa seperti one of the, the majority of, dan a number of membuat kalimat terdengar jamak, padahal kata kerjanya ditentukan oleh kata benda utama. Dengan memeriksa kata benda utama, kamu bisa memilih kata kerja yang benar.

sections.heading: One of the dan only one of
sections.bodyMd: Pada **one of the**, kata kerja tunggal walaupun kata benda di belakangnya jamak: **One of the books is missing.** Pola **only one of** juga tunggal: **Only one of the libraries is open.**

sections.heading: The majority of dan a percentage of
sections.bodyMd: **The majority of** mengikuti kata benda di belakang of: **The majority of visitors are happy.** **A percentage of** juga mengikuti kata benda di belakang of: **A percentage of students is absent.** Periksa kata benda di belakang of untuk memilih kata kerja.

sections.heading: The number of dan a number of
sections.bodyMd: **The number of** memakai kata kerja tunggal: **The number of visitors is growing.** **A number of** memakai kata kerja jamak: **A number of students are waiting.** Kedua pola ini sering tertukar, jadi periksa kata sebelum of.

block3.title: Survei Perpustakaan Kota
block3.text:
A recent report from a local library describes the reading habits of its visitors. Most of the information in the report comes from a survey that asked people about their favorite books. The majority of visitors said they read at least one book each month, but the results also showed some surprises.

One portion of the survey focused on children. A large percentage of the young readers chose adventure stories, while several other groups preferred science books. Numerous parents said that the library helped their children learn to read more confidently. The library also has a collection of old newspapers, and a series of talks is held there every Saturday.

The survey also asked about the number of books people borrow each year. The average amount was higher than expected. One of the librarians explained that the variety of books in the library is one reason. Each section has something new to offer, from poetry to history.

Another part of the report looked at the students who visit after school. One of the students who answered the survey said the library is her favorite place to study. Several of her friends agree with her, and a few of them now come every day. The staff were pleased, but they also noticed that a number of visitors still do not know about the online catalogue.

For this reason, the library plans to add more signs and a short guide near the entrance. The director believes that a simple guide can help the majority of visitors find what they need. The report ends with a clear message: when people understand the variety of services, they use the library more often. That is why the number of visitors may grow next year.
